title: I Used the Package-Room Camera on the Neighbor Who Took My Labeled Box

parts.text: I opened the package room at 6:22 p.m. and my labeled box was gone. Neighbor Bram had the room camera still on his back as he walked out. I was thirty-three, tenant, holding a tracking still that listed my unit. I photographed the empty shelf, the label stub, and the camera board. Then I asked the desk for the clip. At 6:31 the desk pinged Bram with my tracking number. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Bram brought the box down. Policy now has a second line: LABELS ARE UNITS, NOT HALLWAYS. I keep the still. The room finally looks like a shelf, not a buffet.

social.video_title: The neighbor walked out with my labeled box — Part 1/1
social.description: Empty shelf, a camera on his back, a tracking still. Would you have asked for the clip?
